problem.statement_latex: Given $f\in\mathbb F_q[x]$ of degree $n$, output its monic irreducible factors and multiplicities. The field and coefficients have explicit finite encodings; complexity counts bit operations.

quantum.headline_latex: $O(n^{4/3+o(1)}\log^{2+o(1)}q)$ expected time by Doliskani; typical factor-degree patterns admit $O(n^{1+o(1)}\log^{2+o(1)}q)$.
quantum.headline_text: $O(n^{4/3+o(1)}\log^{2+o(1)}q)$ expected time by Doliskani; typical factor-degree patterns admit $O(n^{1+o(1)}\log^{2+o(1)}q)$.

classical.headline_latex: $O(n^{3/2+o(1)}\log^{1+o(1)}q+n^{1+o(1)}\log^{2+o(1)}q)$ randomized time by Kedlaya--Umans modular-composition factorization. The improvement depends on the relative growth of $n$ and $\log q$.
classical.headline_text: $O(n^{3/2+o(1)}\log^{1+o(1)}q+n^{1+o(1)}\log^{2+o(1)}q)$ randomized time by Kedlaya–Umans modular-composition factorization. The improvement depends on the relative growth of $n$ and $\log q$.
